snippet.title: Dream Domain Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The official announcement trailer for Dream Domain! 

Check out the steam page here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4558440/Dream_Domain/

Dream Domain is a retro inspired action adventure where you explore surreal, procedurally generated dream worlds in order to gain your freedom and unravel the game’s mysteries. Your adventure begins locked in a mysterious bedroom. The door will not budge. Trapped with little else but a bed, sleep holds the key to your salvation. In your dreams you will collect items, traverse strange environments, solve puzzles, and defend yourself against horrific nightmares. Surface level dreams can be safe and comforting, but the deeper you travel into the dream world, the more dangerous and unstable they become. What’s the worst that can happen? When you get too frightened, you just wake up in your bedroom, right?

Your dream world is personalized and procedurally generated with thousands of possible combinations, ensuring your experiences will be unique. If you conquer your dream world, a new one will be seamlessly generated, and your adventure will continue. You could stay in your dreams forever…
